desc.zh: 从 A、B 的三次播放出发，推导新歌与重播的计数递推。
desc.en: Count tiny A/B playlists, then derive the new-song and replay transitions.

complexity: O(goal * n) time; O(n) auxiliary space

concepts.name: Playlist counting by used-song count
concepts.description: Partition extensions into a new song or an eligible replay.

concepts.name: Rolling count rows
concepts.description: Keep the previous length row while constructing the next one.
